initial_prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a polished Korean mobile-web UX concept storyboard for the existing stock-information service "천하제일 단타대회". This is a realistic product-interface image for design review, not a promotional poster. The intended experience is: arrive to check one number, enjoy the rankings, become curious about another stock, keep browsing.
Output one wide landscape board, approximately 2400 by 1700 pixels. Show THREE large, equally sized tall mobile-web screen panels side by side in left-to-right reading order. Each panel has about a 390x844 viewport ratio, scaled up for excellent readability. No photographed phone bodies, no perspective, no desktop monitor, no extra miniature screens. Keep an elegant shallow outer margin, show full unclipped screens. Above the panels put the board's concept title in readable Korean. Beneath the panels use only the concise captions "순위 발견", "종목 확인", "이어서 탐색", joined by subtle arrows. This board is a journey storyboard, and every screen must feel like a usable page in the SAME product. Korean text should be clean, verbatim, and legible; prefer fewer bigger labels over fine print.
Shared brand: show the full existing name "천하제일 단타대회" in the header of each screen with expressive Korean Myeongjo ExtraBold lettering, "천하제일" vermilion and "단타대회" golden yellow, a small yellow circular emblem with a red five-point star between the words. Retain the name and nostalgic tournament warmth, express through original type and graphic rhythm. Use modern clear Korean sans-serif for data. Body text dark and easy to read. All screens display the readable label "예시 데이터". Every financial number is deliberately synthetic sample content, never present it as current market data. Keep the SAME scope throughout: individual listed common stocks, not combined corporations.
SCREEN 1, rankings: compact brand header, useful search field labeled "종목 검색", metric navigation "시가총액", "PER", "배당". Title "종목 시가총액". Show a readable coherent ordered ranking list with headings "순위", "종목", "시가총액". Exact rows: "1 삼성전자 495조 유지"; "2 SK하이닉스 237조 ↑1"; "3 LG에너지솔루션 88조 ↓1"; "4 삼성바이오로직스 77조 ↑1"; "5 현대차 55조 ↓1". Visually select the SK하이닉스 row, with a clear detail-opening affordance. Rank and rank movement are grouped; do not add stock-price percentages to the ranking list. Give top ranks genuine color and identity without making all rows separate floating cards. End with a small understated "전체 순위 CSV" utility link, lower in hierarchy than stock exploration. Real list content should occupy most of the viewport, not a large hero.
SCREEN 2, selected stock: compact same brand header and back link "시가총액 순위"; title "SK하이닉스", secondary "보통주 · 예시 데이터". Immediately and clearly answer "시가총액 237조" and "2위". Show "이전 3위 → 현재 2위" as rank movement, separated from the stock-price line "주가 326,000원" with "+1.20%" in Korean-market up red. One simple useful chart titled "시가총액 추이", a clear final point at 237조 and 3-month sample evolution, no invented live ticks or candles. Beneath the chart, a visibly useful affordance "가까운 순위 보기" and a short teaser of nearby stocks. Keep one clear reading order; no repeated grids of the same current number.
SCREEN 3, continue exploring: same brand header, back link "SK하이닉스"; title "가까운 시가총액 순위", readable "예시 데이터". Show connected neighboring ranks, not a bracket: "1위 삼성전자" with "495조" and "258조 더 큼"; current position "2위 SK하이닉스" with "237조"; "3위 LG에너지솔루션" with "88조" and "149조 더 작음". Make relationships intuitively clear and neighboring entries clearly tappable. Show the LG에너지솔루션 entry activated with a compact anchored quick-preview surface beneath or alongside it, as a plausible tap state that can also be a desktop hover. Preview repeats only "LG에너지솔루션", "88조 · 3위" and action "종목 보기". Do not obscure the main comparison. Hint that ranking context is retained when moving onward.
Interaction intent should read visually through selected state, coherent navigation, and that single preview. No fingers, cursor giant graphics, animation trails, gratuitous confetti, star ratings, trading controls, portfolios, signup, prize pools, tournament participation, buy/sell recommendations, fake market intelligence, claims of real-time data, real brands' logos, literal anime characters, or copyrighted scenes. No purple SaaS gradients, glassmorphism, excessive rounded KPI tiles, black neon crypto dashboard, or grey admin dashboard. Flat readable interfaces with intentional color, crisp alignment, realistic touch targets and restrained functional depth.
CONCEPT B: board title "B · 대회 기록실".
Art direction: a distinctive tournament record annual and well-edited sports record book translated into a bright, tactile-in-rhythm but visually flat Korean mobile product. Crisp cool-white paper-like ground (#FAFCFD), dark ink (#20252A), pale cool-blue index fields (#EDF4FA), vermilion chapter rules and golden-yellow selected index tabs from the existing brand. The brand name stays red and gold; use strong Korean editorial title hierarchy and generous but purposeful spacing. Absolutely not monochrome: top-three rank numerals each have deliberate gold, vermilion and deep-blue ink accents, and the selected row is a bold golden index treatment. Rows form a continuous numbered record ledger with precise columns, short section rules, and tab-like navigation labels. No fake paper folds, grunge, handwritten scribbles, beige magazine mood, leather, or 3D book illustration. The detail feels like opening one specific record: identity, current figure, rank movement, then a single clean chart. The third screen treats neighbors as consecutive records with an elegant connective rule and clear value differences. The preview feels like an informative annotation opened from that record with a clear "종목 보기" action. Friendly grown-up curiosity, collectible record-book rhythm, visible brand personality, calm enough to browse many rows. Both a memorable expressive identity and fast reading must be present. Do not let this become a generic bank app or a card-grid financial dashboard.
final_edit_prompt:
Edit the supplied B concept storyboard. Preserve the same three-screen journey, all five stocks, all exact numbers and gaps, "예시 데이터" on every screen, the full existing red/gold brand name and star emblem, navigation, selected SK하이닉스, and legible large Korean text. Give this specific "대회 기록실" concept a coherent printed tournament-record identity.
1. Remove EVERY invented outer-board paragraph, slogan, recommendation or company description, especially "좋은 종목" and the LG에너지솔루션 promotional sentence. Outer-board text must be ONLY "B · 대회 기록실" above and "순위 발견 → 종목 확인 → 이어서 탐색" below. Remove the bottom blue information callout. Quick preview contains ONLY "LG에너지솔루션", "88조 · 3위", "예시 데이터" and "종목 보기".
2. Replace all shiny gold/silver/bronze medals with FLAT typographic rank numerals, no coins or prizes. Color ranks 1 gold-ochre, 2 vermilion, 3 deep blue; 4 and 5 ink. Keep the selected row as a pale golden index highlight. All rank-movement arrows ↑1 and ↓1 and the previous→current rank text use the SAME neutral ink color. Keep +1.20% red only for the separately labeled stock-price change.
3. Shift the visual structure from pale-blue rounded financial cards to an elegant continuous tournament record ledger: crisp cool-white pages, dark hairline row rules, confident expressive Korean editorial headings, small golden index tabs, vermilion section rules. Open the current metric and rank summary onto the page; remove its rounded blue card. Place the stock-price line on an open ruled baseline. Keep the chart with labels "3개월 전", "2개월 전", "1개월 전", "현재", final value 237조. Use golden tab-like treatment for "가까운 순위 보기" and "종목 보기", not default bright-blue bank-app buttons. Maintain practical touch targets.
4. Nearby ranks should be continuous consecutive record entries joined by a thin ink rule, not three rounded cards. The current 2위 has an unmistakable golden index marker. Preserve exact gaps "SK하이닉스보다 258조 큼" and "SK하이닉스보다 149조 작음". Quick preview is a simple anchored annotation with a top rule, not a nested colored dashboard card. Make entry and action clearly tappable.
Aim for warm familiar curiosity through typography, colored ranking, record-book spacing and navigation. No beige grunge, fake paper folds, 3D book, doodles, SaaS cards, added marketing copy or invented feature. The result should remain an actual usable mobile webpage concept with personality, and clearly distinguish B from the saturated arena of A.
Additional precise UX corrections: on each screen keep "예시 데이터" and a compact "2026.10.08 기준" date, making clear the date belongs to this illustrative sample. In ranking/detail show the concise explanation "순위 이동 · 직전 공개 순위 대비". In screen 3 stock names/rows are direct links to detail; use a separate small optional "미리보기" disclosure on the LG에너지솔루션 row to open the annotation, so navigating to another stock does not require opening a preview first. Show this disclosure expanded. Inside the preview add the factual identity line "보통주 · 373220" to give it a useful detail beyond the repeated amount, plus the previously specified action. The optional preview should have a clear visual anchor to its triggering row.
